spans.s: paudgalika, adj. (Pali puggalika; to pudgala plus ika; in different sense recorded pw 〔4.302〕), individual, personal, always contrasted with sāṃghika, sometimes also staupika: sāṃghikāḥ puṣpavṛkṣāḥ … ˚ka-paribhogena bhuktāḥ Divy 〔342.19〕, … were put to individual, personal (not selfish with Index) use; staupikaṃ sāṃghikaṃ … vittaṃ ˚kaṃ ca RP 〔29.8〕; similarly Śikṣ 〔63.14〕; Bbh 〔166.26〕; MSV 〔ii.123.19〕.
